title: Performance enhancement of inverted perovskite solar cells through lithium-ion diffusion from the nickel oxide hole transport layer to the perovskite absorber
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00072F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pravakar P. Rajbhandari, Bipin Rijal, Zeying Chen, Ankit Choudhary, Haralabos Efstathiadis, Tara P. Dhakal
Doping lithium into nickel oxide not only improves its electrical conductivity but also facilitates lithium-ion diffusion into the perovskite, enhancing the quality of the absorber and, consequently, the performance of the solar cell.
